checks.builtin_fix: Ask the cluster admin to bind a role that grants the missing permissions to this identity. For `create namespaces`: `kubectl create clusterrole rdy-installer --verb=create --resource=namespaces`, then `kubectl create clusterrolebinding rdy-installer --clusterrole=rdy-installer --user=<user>`. For each other permission, add a `--verb` and `--resource` pair to the same role. A namespaced item needs its own role and rolebinding in its namespace, so repeat both commands per namespace. Cluster-scoped items and URLs go in a clusterrole. On a throwaway test cluster only, `cluster-admin` works.
